concepts.gloss_en: the small/lesser luminary (Gen. 1:16), a symbol for Malkhut/moon/night — applied as an aspect to night, prayer, sleep, the child (yanuka)

reason_for_human: All five occurrences are the same fixed expression 'the small/lesser luminary' from Genesis 1:16 ('את המאור הקטן לממשלת הלילה'). The two vocalizations seen (הַקָּטָן vs הַקָּטֹן) are merely plene/defective spellings of the same adjective 'small', not a homograph. Though it is applied metaphorically to different partners (night, prayer, sleep, yanuka), the underlying concept is identical, so it stays one concept.
